mapper.sql: it.id AS inbound_item_id, ib.id AS inbound_id, ib.doc_no, ib.shipment_id, ib.store_id, ib.status, it.seller_sku, COALESCE(l.pack_qty, 1) AS pack_qty, it.qty / COALESCE(l.pack_qty, 1) AS shipped_qty, rc.received_qty FROM ecom_inbound ib JOIN ecom_inbound_item it ON it.inbound_id = ib.id LEFT JOIN ecom_listing l ON l.store_id = ib.store_id AND l.seller_sku = it.seller_sku LEFT JOIN ecom_fba_inbound_receipt rc ON rc.inbound_item_id = it.id
mapper.select: SELECT WHERE ib.id = #{inboundId} AND it.part_main = 1 ORDER BY it.id
